resolution: Source retains only the bounded three-block chunk neighborhoods around CW07 and HS02 with plugin-owned Paper chunk tickets before every fixture rebind, then applies the original strict exactly-one-control audit. The pure policy proves edge/corner/negative coordinates retain no more than four chunks per site. After the exact physical pass and sites.yml commit, the Deep Hold builder flushes exact blocks, books, marker entities, and sites before rebind or cross-world play. The Unlit light scan snapshots same-world unlit_safe sites once per scan. Every generated evaluation handle, plus the distinct CW07 and HS02 controls, now has a non-relocatable authored ceiling-support cell; the installer places support before control, pins exact ceiling attachment, and audits Paper BlockData.isSupported rather than inferring support from material solidity. Full plugin build/self-tests and a fresh create-only retry remain required.
